ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

2. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.
   D. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

4. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.
   D. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.
   D. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.
   B. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Saum has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.

12. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

13. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.
   C. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.
   D. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.
   B. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Hajj and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues: Ibadah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship with people of other faiths 03 6.3 Corruption 04 7 History of Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Relations with people of other faiths and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Corruption 04 7 History of Islam 7.1 Battle of Badr and Uhud 04 7.2 Treaty of Hu and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
